Booking & price

Clear answers about prices, payments, reservations and cancellation terms.

Is direct booking the best available price?

In most cases, yes. On the official Villas Pastura website we aim to offer our best rates and extra benefits for direct guests. If you find a better offer for the same dates, number of guests and booking terms, please contact us and we will gladly review it.

What is included in the displayed price?

The displayed total includes accommodation, tourist tax and final cleaning. There are no additional mandatory charges beyond the total shown at checkout. You can review the full price breakdown before confirming your booking.

How are payment and booking confirmation handled?

Villas Pastura is professionally managed by Ventus Travel, a local agency with over 15 years of experience in Novalja. You can pay by secure 3-D Secure payment link through our partner Monri or by bank transfer using the provided instructions. Your reservation is processed through our booking system and you receive payment instructions and confirmation of its status. We never store card details on our website.

Which cancellation terms apply?

Cancellation terms depend on your stay dates and selected offer. All applicable deadlines, refund conditions and any charges are shown clearly before you confirm the booking.

Is tourist tax included?

Yes. Tourist tax is included in the total price and itemised in the breakdown. You will not have to pay it separately on arrival.

The villa & pool

Privacy, comfort, heated pools and house information.

Are both villas and their pools completely private?

Each villa offers complete privacy, with its own entrance, fenced terrace and private heated pool. No outdoor facilities are shared.

Is the villa genuinely comfortable at full capacity?

Yes. Each villa has four spacious double bedrooms, each with its own bathroom, and comfortably accommodates eight guests without temporary extra beds.

What does a heated pool mean in practice?

Both villas have private heated pools. Heating is especially useful in spring and September, when mornings and evenings are cooler. In the warmest summer weeks it is usually unnecessary, but it remains available on request at no extra charge. Outdoor water temperature also depends on the weather.

How suitable is the villa for small children?

Families with young children are welcome. The outdoor area is fenced, and a baby cot can be arranged on request. Adults must supervise children at all times, especially near the swimming pool.

Which house rules should guests know before booking?

Please treat the villa with care and respect the neighbourhood. Quiet hours run from 11 PM to 7 AM. Normal conversation is fine, but loud parties or behaviour disturbing others are not permitted.

Arrival & location

Useful details about arriving and settling in.

Do we need a car when staying at Villas Pastura?

Not necessarily, but we recommend a car for exploring Pag comfortably. The villas are in a peaceful, private setting and the nearest beach is within walking distance. Restaurants, shops and most other attractions are easier to reach by car.

How do arrival and check-in work?

A member of our local team will welcome you personally. We coordinate your arrival on check-in day by WhatsApp, email or phone. Direct guests benefit from priority check-in and complimentary early check-in when available.

Where do guests park and charge an electric car?

Private on-site parking is included in your stay. Direct-booking guests can also use our 22 kW EV charger free of charge.

Is the nearest beach practical for families?

Terra is the nearest beach and is within walking distance. Families may also enjoy Planjka in Stara Novalja, recognised with the Blue Flag for standards related to water quality, environment, safety and facilities. Jadrišnica in Jakišnica is another option. Ask our team for advice based on your needs and the day's conditions.

What happens if we arrive late?

No worries. Our local team will welcome you personally regardless of the hour, even in the middle of the night. Just let us know if your plans change so we can coordinate your arrival.

Local host advice

Personal local tips and support from our team.

Where would our hosts go for dinner on the first evening?

For a special first evening in Novalja, our personal recommendation is Starac i More, a lovely choice for a more refined dining experience. We suggest booking a table in advance in summer.

Which beach works best for different wind conditions?

Choosing another side of Pag can help when the wind changes. In a southerly jugo wind, Caska and Zrće are often more sheltered; Planjka in Stara Novalja can also be suitable. During the northeasterly bura, we often suggest Babe or Planjka. Conditions vary, so ask our team on the day.

Who helps us if we need something during the stay?

The local Ventus Travel team looks after cleaning, maintenance and practical support at Villas Pastura. Whether you need help with the property or want a local recommendation, we are here. Our contact details are provided at check-in and on this website.
